rows.method_detail: DMRG and FAMPS (fully augmented MPS) on L x 2L cylinders, L = 8 to 16, periodic in y and open in x; each size extrapolated to zero truncation error, then linear in 1/L
rows.method_as_published: DMRG/FAMPS; 'linear extrapolation of the energy with 1/L'
rows.bound_type_reason: extrapolation to an infinite ansatz or to infinite size; not an upper bound (RULES.md 14.4)
rows.reference: Qian, Lv, Lee & Qin, From the Shastry-Sutherland model to the J1-J2 Heisenberg model, arXiv:2411.17452 (version dated 27 Nov 2024)

(3), lines 100-110: H = J1 sum_<ij> S_i.S_j + J3 sum_<<ij>> in blue S_i.S_j + J3' sum in red S_i.S_j; J3' = 0 is the Shastry-Sutherland model (J1 on the square bonds, J3 on the blue orthogonal dimers); alpha := J1/J3 = 0.80 (line 412); energies per site in the S.S convention, J3 = 1. Check: the 6x6 periodic exact value printed at alpha = 0.80, -0.4517531 (line 420), equals the exact energy per site of ShastrySutherland/square_36_P_J0.8_Jd1 in data/ (-0.4517531), so J = 0.8, Jd = 1 and the unit is the same. Spin-1/2 (S operators). Stored per site x 4 (S.S to Pauli) by the loader. No error bar on the 6x6 value is needed. New instance: the loader's tdlId has no ShastrySutherland entry (id by RULES 2.1: J then Jd).
